environment.description: AWS Lambda function behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB) with a public-facing listener on port 443. The ALB target group forwards HTTP requests directly to the Lambda function. The ALB uses a standard ACM certificate for server-side TLS only. No authentication is configured on the ALB listener rules. The Lambda function has the execution role with AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole and runs in a VPC with outbound internet access via NAT gateway. Security group allows all outbound traffic.
